description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the application from the end-of-support JDK 1.8 to a supported long-term Java version.
tasks.reason: JDK 1.8 has reached the end of support, posing security and maintainability risks. A supported long-term Java version is required before other transforms.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the project runtime and build configuration from Java 1.8 to a supported long-term Java version (target the latest supported LTS reported by the assessment). Update the Maven compiler configuration accordingly. Addresses issues: Java Version Upgrade (rule azure-java-version-01000). The project must build successfully and all existing tests must pass after the upgrade.

tasks.description: Move the application to an up-to-date Jakarta EE baseline.
tasks.reason: The current Jakarta EE version is not the latest stable, which limits compatibility with modern runtimes and Azure services.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the application to an up-to-date Jakarta EE baseline, migrating any javax.* usage to jakarta.* as required. Addresses issues: Framework Upgrade (rule jakarta-ee-version-01000). The project must build successfully and all existing tests must pass after the upgrade.

tasks.description: Replace retired legacy Azure SDKs for Java with the current, supported Azure SDKs.
tasks.reason: The legacy com.microsoft.azure.* SDKs have reached end of support; the current com.azure.* SDKs are required for security, supportability, and managed-identity authentication.
tasks.requirements: Migrate from the legacy Azure SDKs for Java (com.microsoft.azure.*) to the latest supported Azure SDKs (com.azure.*). Update dependencies, client initialization, and related code paths. Prefer Managed Identity for authentication unless otherwise specified. Addresses issues: Azure SDKs Version Upgrade (rule azure-java-sdk-legacy-migration-01000, 19 incidents in AzureInitialization.java, ResourceGroupTaggingInterceptor.java, and pom.xml). The project must build successfully and all existing tests must pass after migration.

tasks.description: Configure system environment variables so configuration is portable to Azure compute.
tasks.reason: Configuration is currently read from system environment variables/system properties in a way that is not portable to Azure-hosted compute.
tasks.requirements: Externalize and standardize configuration currently read from system environment variables and system properties so it is portable to Azure compute environments. Addresses issues: Configuration Management (rule azure-system-config-01000, 7 incidents in AzureInitialization.java and ResourceGroupTaggingInterceptor.java). The project must build successfully and all existing tests must pass after the change.

tasks.description: Migrate direct local file system access to Azure Storage Account File Share mounts.
tasks.reason: Direct local file system access is not durable or portable on Azure compute; mounted Azure Storage File Shares provide cloud-ready, shared, persistent storage.
tasks.requirements: Replace direct local file system access (Java IO) with Azure Storage Account File Share mounts, using a configurable mount path. Prefer Managed Identity for authentication unless otherwise specified. Addresses issues: File System Management (local Java IO usage). The project must build successfully and all existing tests must pass after migration.

tasks.description: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate identified vulnerabilities before deployment.
tasks.reason: The modernized application must be free of known dependency vulnerabilities before it is packaged and deployed.
tasks.requirements: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate identified vulnerabilities. Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to the minimum patched version. If a CVE fix requires a major version upgrade, document the affected dependency, the current version, the upgraded major version, and the breaking change risk. Verify that the project builds and all tests pass after remediation.

tasks.description: Create a Dockerfile so the application can run inside containers on Azure Container Apps or AKS.
tasks.reason: No Dockerfile exists; container packaging is required for the application to run on Azure Container Apps or AKS.
tasks.requirements: Create a Dockerfile and required container build configuration so the application can run inside containers, targeting Azure Container Apps / AKS container readiness. Addresses issues: Containerization (No Dockerfile found). The container image must build successfully.
